bio: Dr. Ma is currently a Full Professor with the Electronic Information School, Wuhan University, Wuhan, China. He has received the BS degree of Information and Computing Science, and the PhD degree of Control Science and Engineering, both from Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, China, in 2008 and 2014, respectively. From September 2012 to September 2013, he was an exchange student in Department of Statistics, University of California, Los Angeles, supervised by Prof. Alan L. Yuille. He was a Post-Doctoral with the Electronic Information School, Wuhan University from August 2014 to May 2016, and received an accelerated promotion to Associate Professor and Full Professor in June 2016 and December 2018, respectively. Dr. Ma has received several best paper awards, including IEEE SPS Best Paper Award 2025, Information Fusion Best Paper Award 2024, Hsue-shen Tsien Paper Award 2023, etc.
research: Generally speaking, my research interests lie in computer vision and machine learning. My current research is mainly focused on point/feature/image matching/registration, and also includes information fusion, image super resolution, hyperspectral image analysis, infrared imaging, etc.
activities: Co Editor-in-Chief for Information Fusion and Chinese Journal of Information Fusion;

Associate Editor/Editorial Board Member for IEEE Transactions on Image Processing, IEEE/CAA Journal of Automatica Sinica, Geo-spatial Information Science, Neurocomputing, Image and Vision Computing, Frontiers in Neuroscience;
Youth Editor for The Innovation, Fundamental Research, Journal of Image and Graphics (中国图象图形学报);
General Co-Chairs for IEEE/CAA Journal of Automatica Sinica, Symposium Series 3 "Multi-source Information Perception and Fusion" [call for paper];
